title: Labeling for UWB Ranging in Weak NLOS Conditions
authors: Philipp Peterseil | David Märzinger | Bernhard Etzlinger | Andreas Springer
finding: Packet-specific labels are derived from propagation features within a three-packet two-way exchange. The 36 acquisition sets vary antenna angle, obstacle and fixed reference separation.
rights: Public JKU institutional manuscript. Bibliographic metadata and original summary only.

title: Data Trustworthiness for UWB Ranging in IoT
authors: Philipp Peterseil | Bernhard Etzlinger | David Märzinger | Roya Khanzadeh | Andreas Springer
locator: PDF pp. 4–5, §§V.A–C, Tables I–II, Fig. 7 and refs. [20–21]
finding: The asymmetric reply intervals change how much individual packets contribute to a range estimate. Filtering affects both error and the fraction of observations retained. The public static weak-NLOS data is identified in ref. [21].
rights: Public JKU institutional manuscript. Bibliographic metadata and original summary only.

title: Removing the Need for Ground Truth UWB Data Collection: Self-Supervised Ranging Error Correction Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
authors: Dieter Coppens | Ben van Herbruggen | Adnan Shahid | Eli de Poorter
finding: The experiment compares mobile-robot two-way ranging against an optical tracking system. The paper reports 3,463 and 1,434 samples in campaigns six months apart. The two files linked from the public card have a different temporal relationship, documented in ghent-motion-summary.csv.
rights: Publisher lists CC BY 4.0; public journal PDF deposited at Ghent.

title: UWB TDoA Error Correction Using Transformers: Patching and Positional Encoding Strategies
authors: Dieter Coppens | Adnan Shahid | Eli De Poorter
locator: Institutional PDF is arXiv:2507.03523v1, pp. 4–5, Table II
finding: Independent optical tracking measures robot position in a warehouse. The two trajectories in Table II use 15 anchors. This paper supports the setup and companion collection; those 15-anchor training and evaluation counts are separate from the Random member audited here.
rights: Public arXiv v1 hosted by Ghent. Bibliographic metadata and original summary only.

title: Beyond Convolutions: Transformer Networks for Improved UWB CIR-based Fingerprinting
authors: Dieter Coppens | Adnan Shahid | Eli De Poorter
finding: A reference anchor transmits synchronization packets and estimates of relative clock skew calibrate channel responses. Four mobile-robot trajectories include three line-of-sight runs and one obstructed run.
rights: Public Ghent institutional manuscript. Bibliographic metadata and original summary only.

authors: Phuong Bich Duong | Ben Van Herbruggen | Arne Bröring | Adnan Shahid | Eli De Poorter
locator: Institutional manuscript PDF p. 3, §III and Fig. 1

rights: Public Ghent institutional manuscript. Bibliographic metadata and original summary only.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Automatic Run-Time Adaptation of UWB PHY Radio Settings
authors: Dieter Coppens | Adnan Shahid | Eli De Poorter
locator: Institutional manuscript PDF p. 11, measurement setup, Table VI
finding: Each of 15 physical UWB nodes takes a turn as the tag and ranges to the other 14 at 72 physical-layer settings. These tests characterize radio links between fixed devices.
rights: Public Ghent submitted manuscript. Bibliographic metadata and original summary only.

authors: Jaron Fontaine | Matteo Ridolfi | Ben Van Herbruggen | Adnan Shahid | Eli De Poorter
locator: §V, Fig. 5. §VI, Table 4 and edge latency discussion

authors: Matteo Ridolfi | Jaron Fontaine | Ben Van Herbruggen | Wout Joseph | Jeroen Hoebeke | Eli De Poorter

title: Crowdsourcing-Assisted Radio Environment Database for V2V Communication
authors: Keita Katagiri | Koya Sato | Takeo Fujii
finding: Receiving vehicles save successfully decoded packets. Reported signal strength is aggregated by transmitter and receiver location. Observing both locations in one decoded record cannot provide an independent transmit log or the number of missed packets.
rights: Publisher lists CC BY 4.0; public publisher PDF.
